identity.name: Attack Surface Scanner
identity.creator: external-threat-team
identity.target_scope: External public assets, subdomains, and cloud resources of company.com

intent.what_is_normal:
Standard web services running on ports 80 and 443 with valid SSL certificates.
Expected subdomains: www, mail, api, admin.
Cloud storage buckets should be private and not publicly accessible.
intent.what_is_not_normal:
- Open ports beyond 80/443 (SSH, RDP, database ports)
- Exposed S3/Azure/GCP buckets with public read access
- SSL certificates expiring within 30 days
- Weak TLS configurations (TLS 1.0, weak ciphers)
- Unexpected subdomains that could indicate shadow IT
intent.overlooked_edge_cases:
- CDN services (Cloudflare, Akamai) may mask origin servers
- Rate limiting may affect scan results
- Web application firewalls may block scanning attempts
- Some cloud buckets may have regional restrictions
